programme.title: Young Adult
programme.desc: A writer (Charlize Theron) unexpectedly bonds with a former classmate (Patton Oswalt) after she returns home to relive her glory days and steal her now-married high-school sweetheart.

programme.title: Young Frankenstein

programme.title: Class of 1984

programme.title: Black Christmas

programme.title: Perry Mason: The Case of the Scandalous Scoundrel

programme.desc: A Texas anthropologist (Harvey Korman) returns from Peru with a furry little creature who gets out of control.
